new: Docker guardian image cleanup runs only when `pi-phase status` reports no active phases or only `build`, `test`, or `ci`. An active integration phase or unknown phase status blocks image removal even under disk pressure. At or above the cleanup floor (40 GiB by default), it protects pinned globs (`~/.pi/agent/docker-guardian/pinned.txt`), floating tags and images younger than 6 h. Below the floor, pins and floating tags no longer protect images and the minimum age drops to 1 h. It keeps all container-used images and uses only `docker rmi` without force. Under confirmed local disk pressure, build cache retention drops to 0 even if the image pass is skipped.
reason: Clarify the fail-closed phase gate and separate image safety from build-cache retention under disk pressure (#245).
